COD da odar biyan kuɗi na al'ada yakamata suyi amfani da hanyar haɗin oda na Siyarwa har sai lokacin. Idan ba a canza takarda ba tukuna, abokin ciniki yana ganin sanarwa maimakon PDF.

set.smtpGmailHint: Gmail yana buƙatar kalmar wucewa ta App, ba kalmar sirri ta yau da kullun ba.
set.smtpGmailStep1: Danna Yi amfani da Gmel a ƙasa - mai masaukin baki, tashar jiragen ruwa 587, da TLS suna cika ta atomatik.
set.smtpGmailStep2: Shigar da cikakken Gmel ɗin ku Daga imel da sunan mai amfani (misali you@gmail.com).
set.smtpGmailStep3: Kunna Tabbatar da Mataki 2 a cikin Google Account ɗin ku, sannan ƙirƙirar kalmar wucewa ta App. Yi amfani da kalmar wucewa anan - ba kalmar sirrin Gmail ɗin ku ta al'ada ba.
set.smtpGmailStep4: Manna da App Password a cikin Kalmar wucewa filin.
set.smtpGmailStep5: Danna Ajiye a saman wannan shafin.
set.smtpMissingBody: Saita SMTP anan kafin amfani da Aika Imel. Ba tare da SMTP ba, ba za a iya aika imel ɗin daftarin aiki daga app ɗin ba.
set.smtpPasswordKeep: Bar komai don ci gaba da wanzuwa
set.smtpReadyBody: Daftarin imel zai aika ta wannan uwar garken lokacin da kake amfani da Aika Imel. Kunna haɗe-haɗe na PDF a cikin samfuran Imel.
set.smtpWebStep1: Danna Yi amfani da saƙon gidan yanar gizon da ke ƙasa - Matsalolin Hostinger cika ta atomatik (smtp.hostinger.com, tashar jiragen ruwa 465, SSL). Canja mai watsa shiri idan kun yi amfani da wani mai badawa.
set.smtpWebStep2: Hostinger: kiyaye tashar jiragen ruwa 465 tare da kashe TLS (SSL). Ga sauran masu samarwa, tashar jiragen ruwa 587 + Yi amfani da TLS na kowa ne.
set.smtpWebStep3: Cika Daga imel, Daga suna, sunan mai amfani (cikakken imel), da kalmar sirrin akwatin gidan waya.
set.smtpWebStep4: Danna Ajiye a saman wannan shafin, sannan aika imel ɗin takaddar gwaji.
set.smtpWebmailHint: Hostinger misali: smtp.hostinger.com · tashar jiragen ruwa 465 · SSL
